items.quote: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.
items.claim: Moses tells Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar not to show the usual signs of mourning (uncovering their heads, tearing their clothes). He warns that doing so would bring death on them and wrath on all the people. The rest of the house of Israel is to mourn the burning the LORD had kindled instead.
items.action: forbade mourning rites (uncovering heads, rending clothes)
items.mechanism: Moses warns that if they mourn, they will die and wrath will fall on all the people. Mourning is handed to the wider house of Israel.
